Delhi Fire Services gets 2,345 new posts in 84-year cadre revamp

The Delhi Fire Services (DFS) will receive 2,345 additional posts as part of its first major cadre restructuring in 84 years. This significant change aims to enhance the operational capacity of the DFS.
